svg.text: Wiring set 568-70.9001, sheet 8: PLC (programmable logic controller), console terminal TABLO, inverter UZ1 control side, encoder BR40
table (40): no columns on the paper
(39) ZAPOJENÍ ŘÍDÍCÍHO AUTOMATU - PLC (wiring of the control automaton, PLC)
(40) TABULKA PŘIPOJENÍ ŘÍDÍCÍHO AUTOMATU - PLC A OVLÁDACÍHO TABLA (connection table of the PLC and the control panel)
POHLED ZE ZADNÍ STRANY (view from the rear side)
TABLO = OVLÁDACÍ TABLO (control panel in the console), drawn from its rear
shield (which end is bonded: not printed)
drive (inverter UZ1) function signal (SIGNÁL FUNKCE POHONU)
PLC-TABLO link (PROPOJENÍ PLC-TABLO); (shield connected to the
PLC-TABLO link (PROPOJENÍ PLC-TABLO); metal shell of the connector)
red ink: IN-8.-д. в конце хода пресса со вст.
blue ink by the title block (a later hand):

- Sheet 8 has two parts: (39) the PLC wiring drawing over columns 01-05 and (40) the connection table of the PLC and the control panel, which has no columns. Clean copies 20261114_015721 (top) and 20261114_015117 (bottom); the table and the later ink from 20261113_191800.
- Ruler: the paper marks 01-05 by ticks at irregular places, each over the current path it names; each number stands here at its tick, the boxes end halfway between ticks.

- PLC terminals as printed: OUT 0-D, +24V twice, GND (ground) twice (top strip); IN 0-F, GND twice (bottom strip). The two +24V are one node (the +24V line joins them with a junction dot); so are the two GND of each strip (a bracket on the paper). The netlist names the input-strip GND "IN-GND", as table (40) does.

- PLC terminals with no lead on the paper, not used: inputs IN-3 to IN-7, IN-B, IN-C; outputs OUT-1 to OUT-8, OUT-A. Table (40) does not list them. Photo 144328 agrees for the inputs; on the output row it shows a wire on 9 or 8 [?] and none on A, so outputs 9, B, C and D are drawn dashed.

- TABLO terminals are printed ⏚, − and +; the netlist names them PE (protective earth), - and +24V (+24V is the key of the same conductor in control_wires.csv, where sheet 6 prints "TABLO +24V (8:03)"). The drawing shows the printed signs.

- A lead that ends free with "wire (sheet:column)" continues on that sheet; the reference comes from the same conductor's row in power_wires.csv or control_wires.csv. "(6:15)" under 33X10 is kept as printed (control_wires.csv: 6:14-15).

- Drawn here, not as lines on the paper: the four conductors of the PLC-TABLO link between XC60 and XC70 (the paper shows the arrows "XC70 ⇒ PLC" and "TABLO" over XC60 and lists the contacts in table (40); here they end at the contacts of XC70, circles right of the arrow "XC70 ⇒ PLC"); the two conductors from XC50 to UZ1 7 and 8 (paper: arrow "UZ1",

table rows 6+9 XC50, 4 XC50); the harness to XC4 and BR40, printed as one bus line with slanted entries, is drawn as five parallel conductors (a crossing without a dot is no connection). XC4 is drawn as a box with its contact numbers.
- Dashed ellipses: the cable shields at both halves of XC4, bonded by 7XC4 as printed.

- Dashed line and red [?] = unclear, on the on-site check list of spec/plc_drive.md: outputs 9, B, C and D (the markers of the output row are not readable in photo 144328), the link shield (the paper does not say which end is bonded). A red [?] after a device name: that row of plc_drive_devices.csv is unclear (BR40: type; XC4, XC50, XC60, XC70: plug
type and place, see the device block).

- Table (40): each row is filled from plc_drive_wires.csv (PLC = plc_address or contact, SMĚR (direction) = wire, LINIE (line) = sheet:column of the far end from the same conductor's row of the other thread, else of this sheet); PŘIPOJENÍ - FUNKCE (connection - function) is the printed Czech text, the last column the netlist's English signal. Rows 3

and 5 XC60 also carry the English of the printed remark split over them, "(STÍNĚNÍ PŘIPOJENO NA KOVOVÝ PLÁŠŤ KONEKTORU)" (shield connected to the metal shell of the connector), which belongs to the link shield (the shell row of plc_drive_wires.csv). "GND PLC X5 2:01" is kept as printed: the terminal label says (2:02) and column 01 of sheet 2 is PE,

- Contact functions read off the PLC port legends (estimated, see spec/plc_drive.md): XC60 = the 9-pin D-sub (D-subminiature connector) of port IF1 (interface 1), an RS232 (Recommended Standard 232) serial port: 5 GND, 3 TxD (transmit data), 2 RxD (receive data); XC50 = the ANALOG OUTPUTS port: pin 4 = I1 (current output 1), 6 and 9 = GND.

- Grey italic = later handwriting, quoted, never print. Blue: "OMRON 1000P E6B2-CW26C" (1000P = 1000 pulses per turn); "EUCHNER PA50/Welle 06/Imp. 1000, Ident.Nr. 075043, Volt 5-30, Ver. 24, Seriennummer: 9813 12 344" (Welle = shaft, Imp. = pulses per turn, Ident.Nr. = identification number, Ver. = version [?], Seriennummer = serial number) bracketed

"BR40", and "PA50-06-1000-24" (encoder type candidates). Red, left of the table: "IN-8.-д. в конце хода пресса со вст." (IN-8 - д. = датчик, sensor, at the end of the clamp stroke; "со вст." not resolved [?]) against the printed IN-8 = K12UZ1 drive signal. Red, right of table rows IN-0 to IN-2: "короткий сто[п] – верх. пол. пр[есса]" (short st[op] -
Devices on this sheet (from plc_drive_devices.csv; [?] = unclear, estimated = with likely error)
PLC [sure] programmable logic controller of the cut cycle and the backgauge: clamp and cut-done inputs, encoder BR40 count, backgauge drive commands to UZ1, feed-cut interlock K2,
air-cushion control, serial link to the console terminal TABLO (COMPACT PLC (ZAPOJENÍ ŘÍDÍCÍHO AUTOMATU - PLC = wiring of the control automaton); OM (operating manual MS 80/115 PS, DS)
p.49 "BR COMP 1-0"); B&R (Bernecker + Rainer) COMPACT P.L.C.: 16 inputs 24 VDC (volts direct current), 14 outputs 24 VDC 1 A per terminal, max. 7 A per P.L.C., fuse 1.25 AT (amperes,
time-lag) (photo 144328); W (web source, weaker evidence): BRCOMP1.0; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 8, column 01-05
TABLO [sure] console operator terminal: keys and display for cut programs and backgauge positions; serial link to the PLC (OVLÁDACÍ TABLO (TABLO; POHLED ZE ZADNÍ STRANY = view from the
rear)); B&R panel: 4E0040.01-590, a keypad module (estimated, by the 4E family, OM p.46), display module 4D1084.00-590, board 22511030/2 (photos); +24 V DC (direct current) (sheet 6:
"TABLO +24V (8:03)"; sheet 8 prints only "+"); place: console; device row: sheet 8, column 01-03
BR40 [?] backgauge position encoder: channels A, B and index I counted by the PLC on IN-F, IN-E, IN-D (SNÍMAČ BR40 (KONEKTOR SNÍMAČE BR40 = connector of sensor BR40); RU (Russian)
абсолютный ротационный датчик (absolute rotary sensor, OM p.41)); sheet 8: pins A, B, I, +, − (incremental A/B/index), +24V supply; type not printed: OM p.46 EUCHNER
P39SSPPBI1000-123-24; ink on sheet 8: EUCHNER PA50/Welle 06/Imp. 1000, Ident.Nr. 075043, Volt 5-30, Ver. 24, Seriennummer 9813 12 344, PA50-06-1000-24; later ink OMRON 1000P E6B2-CW26C;
place: machine; device row: sheet 8, column 04
XC4 [?] connector of sensor BR40 (encoder) (KONEKTOR SNÍMAČE BR40); plug and socket, contacts 1-5 and shell (sheet 8); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 8, column 03-04
XC50 [?] control-system connector (PLC analog outputs to UZ1 7, 8) (KONEKTORY ŘÍDÍCÍHO SYSTÉMU (ŘÍZENÍ RYCHLOSTI SEDLA = backgauge speed control)); 9-pin D-sub (sheet 8); pins 4 and 6+9
used; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 8, column 05
XC60 [?] control-system connector (PLC side of the TABLO link) (KONEKTORY ŘÍDÍCÍHO SYSTÉMU (PROPOJENÍ PLC-TABLO = PLC-TABLO link)); 9-pin D-sub (sheet 8); pins 2, 3, 5 and shell used;
place: cabinet; device row: sheet 8, column 04
XC70 [?] control-system connector (TABLO side) (KONEKTORY ŘÍDÍCÍHO SYSTÉMU (XC70 ⇒ PLC)); pins 2, 3, 5 and shell used (sheet 8); place: console; device row: sheet 8, column 03
X10 [sure] terminal strip in the cabinet (1-6 to M1) (SVORKOVNICE V ROZVADĚČI); 45 terminals + 3 PE (photo); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 2, column 04-09
X5 [sure] working-earth strip: 0 V of all control supplies, bonded to PE (SVORKOVNICE PRAC. (PRACOVNÍ = working) ZEMĚ); 17 terminals drawn; photo about 13; place: cabinet; device row:
UZ1 [sure] M2 feed drive (MĚNIČ); Lenze EVF8202-E-V002; in 1/N/PE (one phase, neutral and protective earth) AC (alternating current) 230 V 9.0 A; out 3/AC 0-230 V 4.0 A 0.75 kW; place:
BMR1 [sure] cut-control module: two-hand start, knife lock, clutch contactors, cut-done signal (MODUL ŘÍZENÍ ŘEZU (PŘIPOJENÍ MODULU ŘÍZENÍ ŘEZU BMR1); RU релейный модуль управления
реза); one relay board, plate "BMR2" (photo 143021), maker not printed or seen; terminals 1-29, 0V (-), +24V (+); OM list 10.2 "BMR.." 900 010 0714; place: cabinet; device row: sheet
K2 [sure] feed-cut interlock (BLOKOVÁNÍ POSUV-ŘEZ) (POMOCNÁ RELÉ K2 – BLOKOVÁNÍ POSUV-ŘEZ); photo: F. (Friedrich) Lütze relay as K1, changeover 11-12-14; coil voltage not read (24 V DC
from the PLC, estimated); OM list 10.2: RE6-0011; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 5-6, column 16; 17
KM8 [sure] blower (air cushion) motor contactor (STYKAČ MOTORU DMYCHADLA KM8); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 12
XC2 [?] table-cabinet interconnection (PROPOJENÍ STŮL–ROZVADĚČ); pins 1-9 used; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 5-6, column 11; 01-08
- Adast Maxima MS 115 PS (serial 578.0009, 1998), PLC and drive control: PLC, console terminal TABLO, inverter UZ1 control side, encoder BR40, backgauge positioning signals.

- Redrawn from the wiring set 568-70.9001 SCHÉMA ZAPOJENÍ (MS 80 PS.DS MS 115 PS.DS), sheet 8; columns as printed; title block of the paper: MS 80 PS.DS, MS 115 PS.DS, SCHÉMA ZAPOJENÍ, 568-70.9001, sheet 8.

- Data: stage_2_electronics/netlist/plc_drive_devices.csv and plc_drive_wires.csv; references from power_wires.csv, control_wires.csv and power_devices.csv; drawn by stage_2_electronics/schemes_2d/plc_draw.py.
- Marks: dashed line or [?] = unclear (on-site check list, spec/plc_drive.md); grey italic = later ink, quoted.
